schema: edge-paths v1: flat Int16 xyz*10 blocks, one per circuit edge, circuit-edge order (fast edges then modulatory edges)
frame: canonical v3: scene = ((x-x_med)*S, (z-z_med)*S, -(y-y_med)*S) -- FlyWire axes, optic lobes on scene X; S=0.00128609 (adaptive, p99.5 radius -> 400 units), medians over circuit neurons; source synapses_connections_783 POST positions
quantization: scene units * 10, Int16 (same convention as fly_brain_positions.bin)

provenance.waypoint_rule: up to 6 pre + 6 post synapse sites per edge, deterministic stride sample, ordered far-to-near along the approach axis
provenance.citation: Dorkenwald et al., Neuronal wiring diagram of an adult brain, Nature 644:1312-1322 (2024). DOI 10.1038/s41586-024-07558-y
